meaning.fp4_available: An exact FP4 model tag is listed by the official Ollama library.
meaning.route_eligible: The listed variant is approved for automatic routing only on the stated provider, platform, architecture and required hardware capabilities.
meaning.not_listed: No exact FP4 tag was found on the official Ollama tag page checked on checked_at; this is not a claim about third-party repositories.

observed_runtime_evidence.summary: Qwen3.5 9B Q4 and NVFP4 artifacts from the Ollama tags loaded on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti with llama.cpp b12649 Windows CUDA 13.5. Both scored 8/8; Q4 median was 125.6 tokens/s, NVFP4 was 135.2 auto and 135.5 W4A4. The upstream source commit is not exposed; this is a provisional artifact-level speed preference, not a quality win.
